findings.scenario: Native dump fails partway (including ENOSPC) but Anvil CLI logs and exits0. A >2-byte truncated file passes current size/hash inspector. Helper durably records it and deletes the good predecessor; owned historical cache is then removed. Candidate data also has no explicit fsync before metadata/deletion.
findings.required: Fsync candidate and retain predecessor until existing next normal Anvil load plus exact canonical head/checkpoint checks establish candidate usability. Preserve corresponding cache until that confirmation. No auto rollback or broad deletion.
findings.sourceEvidence: Pinned Anvil v1.7 cmd.rs dump_state catches write failure and run exits0; local inspector checks hash/size/inode only, not JSON or loaded state.

otherAssessment: Explicit86400 interval, supported owned cache-path,8GiB admission ordering and unchanged historical/proof guards are sound.
Examined existing success/failure/path/mode/inode tests; no second independent source blocker identified.
No native runtime, browser, snapshot or application mutation by reviewer.
repairAgreed: Lead/Design chose deferred deletion using existing load/checkpoint path; no jq/new parser/dependency or separate qualifier run.
